prompts.front: Use case: product-mockup / identity-preserve. Create ONE standalone ecommerce photograph, NOT a collage. Image 1 is the authoritative cream/ivory hoodie, model and mountain setting reference. Image 2 is the authoritative full IIT Mandi institute chest emblem and approved Green Ridge back artwork reference. Preserve the warm ivory pullover hoodie colour, regular relaxed fit, matching cream drawstrings, metal eyelets, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs/hem from Image 1. Use the SAME adult male with short dark hair and trimmed beard from Image 1, black trousers, natural Himalayan mountain backdrop and soft daylight. The left chest MUST carry the COMPLETE original IIT Mandi institute logo from Image 2: bridge, coloured mountain/sun accents and full small stacked wording "Indian Institute of Technology Mandi". Adapt the small institution lettering to dark ink for legibility on cream; keep the complete emblem, not a symbol alone. Back artwork is the SAME Green Ridge layout from Image 2, adapted to cream: exact dark serif text "IIT Mandi", the two flowing green ridge lines, and exact dark tagline "IITians in Himalayas". No CAPRA logo, no additional sleeve branding, no marketing copy, no collage borders, no captions, no watermark. Realistic cotton-fleece texture, coherent construction and print placement across the series. Portrait 1024x1536. FRONT VIEW: three-quarter front portrait with the model looking slightly to the side, framed from head to upper thighs. Entire hoodie from hood to hem clearly visible and unobstructed; arms relaxed, hands near pockets. Show the full IIT Mandi left-chest logo including its institution lettering sharply; back print must not be visible from the front.
